LanguageData.ApplyGelatinization.label: Semi-gelatinization Surgery
LanguageData.ApplyGelatinization.description: Perform semi-gelatinization surgery on a limb. Gel material is injected, then adaptation begins. If adaptation reaches 100% first, modification succeeds; if severity reaches 100% first, the limb is destroyed.
LanguageData.ApplyFullGelatinization.label: Full Gelatinization Surgery
LanguageData.ApplyFullGelatinization.description: Perform full gelatinization surgery on a body that has already completed personality excretion. The entire body enters a race between adaptation and severity; if adaptation reaches 100% first, full gelatinization succeeds, and if severity reaches 100% first, the body collapses completely.
